r_static.definition: fires / tests on the static observed Gaussians during the update (operating_point[row].rate_static of the per-scene records); x1e-3, nominal 1 (q = 0.999). dev = |log10(r / 1e-3)|. 'ours closer' x/N: scenes where ours' dev is smaller than the row's

common_share.note: Gaussians every row scores, % of the observed Gaussians
Gaussians every row scores, % of the observed Gaussians

objects.box: boxes/bbox.txt of each scene (usplat.box3d.read_box_corners, box_extents: side lengths along the box's own axes, sorted)
objects.note: table only: no trend line or correlation (R9)

paired.note: descriptive, test N = 10, positive = first row better (FA: lower); the fused rows' fair baselines are family F2 (configs/nor_fused_prereg.json, not run here)
